overview.description: The Pacer Swan SOS Moderate March ETF (MMAR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The Pacer Swan SOS Moderate (March) ETF (the Fund) seeks to provide investors with returns that, before fees and expenses of the Fund, match those of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust up to a predetermined upside cap, while providing a buffer against the first 15% of Underlying ETF losses. MMAR was launched on Jun 11, 2026 and is issued by Pacer.
